name: Games On Demand
summary: Perth gaming-optimised online network 'Games-on-Demand (G.O.D.)' (Games On Demand Pty Ltd, ACN 105 421 743); members dialled a VPN to play games and download demos; WAIX-class member; defunct by ~2006.

events.details: Games On Demand Pty Ltd ACN 105421743 (ACN 105 series ≈ 2001); WAIX-class member.

events.details: Website gone (no live site) — site replaced by GAMEHEAD retailer.

refs.label: Jan 2006: still the G.O.D. gaming network/ISP site.
By Aug 2007 the domain serves GAMEHEAD, a game retailer; G.O.D. gone between Dec 2006 (last G.O.D. capture) and Aug 2007.
Company formality outlived the site by years.
